description: This file defines classes and methods for configuring and interacting with S3/MinIO-compatible object storage, including uploading files and generating signed URLs.

classes.name: StorageConfig
classes.description: Data class that holds configuration parameters for connecting to S3/MinIO storage, loaded from environment variables.

classes.name: S3StorageService
classes.description: A service class that provides methods to upload files to S3/MinIO storage and generate presigned URLs for accessing stored objects.

methods.name: StorageConfig.from_env
methods.description: Static method that loads storage configuration from environment variables, raising an error if the required bucket name is missing.

methods.name: S3StorageService.__init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the S3 client with the provided configuration.

methods.name: S3StorageService.upload_file
methods.description: Uploads a local file to the specified storage key in the configured bucket, returning the bucket and key.

methods.name: S3StorageService.generate_presigned_url
methods.description: Generates a presigned URL for accessing an object in storage, with a configurable expiry.

methods.name: S3StorageService.object_url
methods.description: Constructs a non-signed URL to the stored object if a public base URL is configured.
